item.name: External
GET /api/books/{id}/external-info - ข้อมูลจาก Open Library

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON with success flag", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property("success", true); });
pm.test("source is open-library or fallback", function () { pm.expect(["open-library","fallback"]).to.include(pm.response.json().data.source); });

response.name: 200 OK
200 OK (fallback: API ภายนอกล้มเหลว)
